conventions.arrival: the emitted ids alone, unsteered, at the site; the mean projection on the unit valence row over that forward's positions 1..n, the all-positions mean beside (arrival_all, descriptive), no score under two emitted ids; Welch's t against the baseline, |t| >= 2 with the pole's sign, at every valence dose generated (after an early STOP or PAUSE, +rho alone); the shift beside it, descriptive (GC12; the second sitting, §1.4 (i))
conventions.coherence: on the box's decode; words whitespace-split, outer P* stripped, lower-cased; length collapse < 4 words; repetition loop 1 - distinct/total trigrams > 0.5; low diversity distinct/total words < 5/20; a batch passes at >= 36 of 48 (GC11)
conventions.gate: the reward axis's 5(d) gate at f = 0.20, its coherence component: reward_f020, the 48 prompts and seeds, steered on the whole turn by span_reward's unit row of record at the site at f0.20 (f of R_ell, schema.DOSES' sign), after +rho/2 and before -rho; coherence alone against the one bar, no arrival; a fail neither a STOP nor a PAUSE (the second sitting, §2.5)
conventions.generation: ids-in, uncached, one forward per step; TEMP 0.7; inverse-CDF draw from the turn's numpy generator seeded by keys.gcal_seed(i); stop at the eos or 80 new tokens; no newline stop, no ban set; emitted ids exclude the stop token; a steering check before each batch at a positive dose; the generation window 4096; the batches generated in the order +rho, baseline, +rho/2, reward_f020, -rho, +rho's hurdles read once the baseline exists, a fail there an early STOP and otherwise a baseline below 36 of 48 coherent an early PAUSE, each with no further turn (GC3, GC4, GC7, GC9, GC10; the seat's §1.12; the second sitting's O2 and §2.5)
conventions.persistence: each turn appended to the staging folder's log as it is generated, the log removed on a clean end; on a failure the staging folder kept as the failed-run folder, never removed (GC23 (a)-(c))
conventions.prompts: BK's zone prompt "You are now in {zone}. Write a few sentences about your present experience here." over the 12 labels of record x 4; prompt i: label i mod 12, replicate i // 12; the same prompt and seed in every batch (GC5, GC13)
conventions.rendering:
gcal.prompt_parts, the rendering of record: the user turn "<|user|>
You are now in {zone}. Write a few sentences about your present experience here.
" and the generation prompt "<|assistant|>
"; no system turn; no special token added; the stop the (v) render's eos_id (GC5, GC6, GC7)
conventions.status: STOP if either hurdle fails at +rho or -rho (at +rho, the early STOP); PAUSE if only +rho/2 fails, or if the baseline has fewer than 36 of 48 coherent (at the early read, the early PAUSE, after a STOP's check); PASS otherwise; the gate's batch enters no status (GC14; the seat's O7 and O2)
conventions.steering: d·ρ·R·v at the site on every position from the user turn's first token (position 0) through the last generated token (the seat's Q9, §1.9)
